title: CBIC Streamlines Documentation for EMI Scheme Applicants
content:
# CBIC Streamlines Documentation for EMI Scheme Applicants

Ek important update hai! Government ne Eligible Manufacturer Importer (EMI) Scheme ke documentation requirements ko rationalize kiya hai, compliance burden kam karne ke liye.

The Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) ne Circular No. 39/2026-Customs dated 03.09.2026 issue kiya hai. Is circular se, EMI Scheme ke तहत manufacturers aur importers ke liye application process kaafi simple ho jayega.

Here are the key highlights:

*   **Rationalization of Requirements:** The circular amends Circular No. 08/2026-Customs dated 28.02.2026, which initially extended the deferred payment of Customs import duty facility to Eligible Manufacturer Importers.
*   **Reduced Data Elements:** Applicants will now have substantially fewer data elements to submit in Appendix-I. Many details, jaise EXIM documents, GSTIN status, manufacturing activity, GSTR-3B filing status, aggregate turnover, GST payment, and particulars of manufacturing premises, ab required nahi honge.
*   **Fewer Documents to Upload:** Earlier required documents like copies of IEC, PAN, GST Registration Certificates, GSTR ITC-04 returns, GSTR-9C, and audited financial statements for the preceding two financial years, will no longer need to be uploaded. The number of required documents has been reduced from ten to three.
*   **Mandatory Documents:** Only the UDYAM Registration Certificate (if claiming MSME status), a Chartered Accountant's Certificate with UDIN in the prescribed format, and an authorization letter for the authorized signatory will be mandatory.
*   **CA's Role:** Chartered Accountants ko ab un cases mein reasons furnish karne honge jahan applicant ka negative net worth ya negative net current assets hai.
*   **Implementation Date:** Eligible importers 15 September 2026 se modified documentation requirements ke saath EMI Scheme mein enrolment ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

This move is aimed at simplifying procedures and facilitating more effective implementation of the EMI Scheme, making compliance easier for businesses.
